facts.claim: AIDAPrima (AIDA Cruises): Entered service 2016; 125,572 GT; 3290 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 300 m length; Hyperion class.
AIDAprima is the flagship of AIDA Cruises, built by Mitsubishi Shipbuilding at their shipyard in Nagasaki, Japan.

catalogSpecs.description: The first Hyperion-class ship, known for its foil-roofed Beach Club, Racer water slide, and extensive organic dining options.
